trial_title: Transcatheter Self-expandable Valve Implantation for the Treatment of Severe Native Aortic Regurgitation

eligibility_table.criterion: Procedural indications: symptomatic severe aortic regurgitation; no symptom plus left ventricular ejection fraction ≤ 55% or left ventricular end-diastolic dimension (LVEDD) > 65mm or left ventricular end-systolic dimension (LVESD) > 50mm;
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has severe aortic stenosis with an EF of 25%, which meets the criteria for procedural indications.

eligibility_table.criterion: Severe aortic valve regurgitation, and mean pressure gradient < 20mmHg; Annular perimeter ≤ 85 mm;
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has aortic stenosis, not regurgitation, and the mean pressure gradient is not provided.
